summary: Today features significant legal developments with the Kerala High Court's ruling and notable retail earnings reports, amidst a declining stock market.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court upheld the State's reconstitution of the Waqf Board, denying a stay on the decision.
The Arvind Store aims to double its business to Rs 2,000 crore within 2-5 years, growing at 20% annually.
Uniqlo India reported a 41% net profit increase to Rs 253 crore for FY26, focusing on expansion.
Haier India plans to invest ₹7,000 crore in a new manufacturing facility in Andhra Pradesh, its largest investment in India.
The Indian stock market saw the Sensex fall over 200 points, with Nifty slipping below 23,100.
